description: This Python module contains utilities for generating Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERD) from SQLAlchemy models, including functions for introspection, ERD generation using Jinja2 templates, and a CLI command to produce the ERD file.

methods.name: sort_data_structure
methods.description: Sorts a data structure by converting it to JSON and back to ensure consistent key ordering.

methods.name: introspect_sqla_model
methods.description: Introspects a SQLAlchemy model to extract class name, table name, fields, and relationships for ERD generation.

methods.name: introspect_models
methods.description: Collects and groups SQLAlchemy models for ERD rendering.

methods.name: generate_erd
methods.description: Generates a PlantUML ERD file from the introspected models using a Jinja2 template.

methods.name: erd
methods.description: CLI command to generate the ERD file, with optional output path.
